title: Arena Mod
description: Mod that adds a /cancel command, custom matrix-related blocks and custom phonk music for my personal server.
body:
**DISCLAIMER: This mod is published on Modrinth for personal reasons !**








This mod is a simple companion for my command-based map I'm making on my personal server.

What's Included:

- 2 Songs.

- A temporarily placeholder block that exists in case I want to add a block,but I'm bored to do the procedure of creating a block. 😂😅

- 1 Matrix block with the placeholder texture in order to make it look corrupted
- 1 No collision version of the Matrix Block



This mod is only available on Fabric 1.19.4. 

For those who downloaded the mod out of curiosity: The only dependency is Fabric API for 1.19.4.







**HOW TO OBTAIN/PLAY CONTENT:**

- Matrix Block: `> /give @s arena:matrix_block`
- Matrix Block Ghost: `> /give @s arena:matrix_ghost_block`
- Placeholder Block: `> /give @s arena:placeholder_block`
- ACIDO III `> /playsound arena:music.voidvault.acido_iii music @s`
- Gameplay phonk: `> /playsound arena:music.voidvault.cyberphonk_stereo music @s` 
 OR 
`> /playsound arena:music.voidvault.cyberphonk_mono music @s`


The difference between `cyberphonk_mono` and `cyberphonk_stereo`:

- `arena:music.voidvault.cyberphonk_mono`: Plays the sound in specific coordinates and changes volume and sound location based on player's position
- `arena:music.voidvault.cyberphonk_stereo`: Plays the sound as a flat music file. No positional data.
